eq: Pop Essence, Cupcake, and whatever other pcons you want.
Run to Rand, use Swap on any Disenchantment Spirits to move them out of the way as you run there.
Once at Rand, run all the way to the back and hide behind the big rock. 2 Stone Summit Warriors will attack you and the rest will ball up.
Put an empathy on the Cleaver and then Wastrels → Tab the group. MAKE SURE YOU CRY OF PAIN HARD RES SKILLS.
May want to use a Scythe here to maintain energy.
Drop Shadow Form, Empathy and Cry of Pain Rand until he dies. A stone will speed this up considerably.
From Rand, run to where Thommis is.
Run past Thommis towards the wall that drops after chest pop.
Empathy the Cleaver and then Wastrel's/Cry Spam the group until all dead other than Thommis.
May want to use a Scythe here to maintain energy.
Kill Thommis. Once again, a stone will speed this up considerably.
Pop Essence, Cupcakes, and whatever other pcons you like.
Swap Disenchantments, run to the Dungeon key.
Get the dungeon key, then run to the gate.
Run to the door before Selvetarm.
If there is a disenchantment, Swap it away.
Touch all of the wraiths and crypts to have them go to you.
Wastrel's and Cry of Pain them down.
Repeat for all pops of wraiths.
MAKE SURE TO TRY AND STAY A DISTANCE FROM THE GATE.
After a few pop ups of Wraiths and Crypts, Touchers will pop. As long as you are over half an aggro bubble away, they will not touch you.
Pull them together then Wastrel's and Cry of Pain them down until the gate opens.
Hug the right wall and run all the way to the back.
Once at the back, grab the groups that circle around but not Selvetarm.
Wastrels and Cry of Pain them down.
Pull Selvetarm and hide behind the big rock.
Empathy the Cleaver (If you have it) and then Wastrel's/Cry/Ether Spam the group until all dead other than Selve.
May want to use a Scythe here to maintain energy.
Run to the right, swap disenchantments.
Run until you get to a circle of Imps.
Aggro the imps, pull them until they ball, then kill them.
The Boss will pop. Pull him and kill him.
Run back to the beginning and go through the gate.
To be safe, kill off the 3-group of Flame Djinns.
You can do 1 of 2 things to kill Forgewight
# Cast Ether Nightmare followed by Wastrel's followed by Cry of Pain on the Dominator, then run away. Rinse and repeat till resses used up and all dead but Forgewight.
# Pull Forgewight's group towards the chest pop location, hide behind wall or find a safe spot away from the Distractor, and use the same process as the previous sections.
Pop a Full Conset, Cupcakes, Apples, Corns, War Supplies etc. whatever you think you might need.
Run to Duncan. Swap Disenchantment Spirits and try to keep space between you and touchers that pop up.
Run to the safe spot to the right if low on health.
If not low on health, run straight up the stairs, trigger dialogue, then Death's Charge back down.
Once spirits pop, Swap disenchants down below ledge. If other disenchants will aggro you while killing Duncan, swap them away too.
Once all disenchants are away, use touchers aggro to sliver duncan down.
Upon his death, all touchers and spirits will disappear.

eq: The farm takes place in Normal Mode, as Unique Items drop chance is the same in NM and HM.
Start from Bergen Hot Springs, head into Cursed Lands from Nebo Terrace. The run should not be a problem whatsoever.
Now the goal is to repeatedly farm the group to your right. This group will usually have one (or two) Peacekeeper Firebrands, one Peacekeeper Enforcer, and one healer.
As soon as you enter the Cursed Lands, don't move (so as not to trigger the Shining Blade ally spawn yet) , cast Drunken Master, Vow of Piety, Grenth's Aura.
If possible, try to position yourself between the enemy ball and the incoming Shining Blade ally. This will prevent the Peacekeeper Enforcer from moving to attack the ally.
Renew your enchantments, keep attacking, spam Chilling Victory and the group should quickly die.
You'll need a few hundred runs before dropping a Firebrand. Know this before committing to this farm.
Try to keep one of your interrupts ready after the healer's death, as the Peacekeeper Enforcer might cast Death Pact Signet.
If you die, clear your Death Penalty by fighting another of the same group after rezoning or use a small DP-removal cons.

Use the scythe during combat to deal melee damage and trigger your damage enchantments.
Switch to your shield set when idle or when either [[Dark Aura@15] or [[Soul Taker@11] have been removed and you find yourself unable to renew them.
Use [[Signet of Mystic Speed@12] so your enchantments [[Masochism@11], [[Dark Aura@15] and [[Soul Taker@11] have no casting time.
Note that they still have their aftercast delay of 0.75 seconds.
You can apply these enchantments right after an attack of yours has hit. This won't negate the aftercast delay, but skip the recovery phase of your auto attack.
Apply masochism first so it boosts the other enchantments. Reapply it before it runs out so it buffs itself.
Once masochism is active, try to cover the other necromancer enchantments with it, as they constitute the core damage dealing mechanic of your build.
As long as both masochism and dark aura are active all your spells will also trigger dark aura. Try to renew your enchantments before they run out to make use of this.
Don't reapply signet of mystic speed before all its charges have been used up. Reapplying the signet does not reset the active signet's remaining amount of charges.
Maintain [[Grenth's Aura@12] and [[Mystic Vigor@0] to counter your health loss.
If possible, cover soul taker and dark aura.
Mystic vigor uses up signet charges. Avoid using it while the signet is still active.
Renew Grenth's aura on recharge during combat. As long as masochism and dark aura are active this means a free extra trigger of area damage.
Position yourself inbetween as many foes as possible and try to hit up to three targets at once.
The damage from dark aura is centered on you, not the attacked foe(s). Your positioning determines how many foes are struck with your damage.
